name: Discovery Phase for PRD Authoring
description: Add 'fade discover' command that captures implementation preferences and context before PRD writing. GSD's /gsd:discuss-phase asks about layout, interactions, API structure, and content tone BEFORE planning. This helps write better PRDs by surfacing decisions upfront.

userStories.title: Interactive discovery session
userStories.description: As a developer planning a feature, I want an interactive discovery session that helps me think through implementation details
acceptanceCriteria: fade discover command launches interactive Claude session
Session asks about: goals, constraints, tech preferences, edge cases
Questions are contextual based on project type (from FADE.md)
Session can be exited early with Ctrl+C
Documented in fade help

userStories.title: Discovery output format
userStories.description: As a developer, I want discovery session output saved in a format useful for PRD writing
acceptanceCriteria: Output saved to fade/discoveries/{slug}.md
Format includes: Summary, Decisions, Open Questions, Suggested Stories
Slug derived from feature name provided at start of session
Output is markdown suitable for reference when writing PRD

userStories.title: Domain-specific questions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want discovery to ask relevant questions based on what I'm building
acceptanceCriteria: If building API endpoint: asks about auth, validation, error handling, response format
If building UI component: asks about layout, interactions, states, accessibility
If building data feature: asks about schema, validation, migrations, backwards compat
Question sets defined in standards/ or embedded in prompt

userStories.title: Generate PRD draft from discovery
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to optionally generate a PRD draft from my discovery session
acceptanceCriteria: fade discover --prd generates PRD JSON after discovery session
PRD includes user stories derived from discussed features
Acceptance criteria derived from decisions made in discovery
PRD marked as draft for human review before activation
Output path: fade/prds/FEAT-NNN-{slug}.json

userStories.title: Codebase-aware discovery
userStories.description: As a developer, I want discovery to understand my existing code so questions are relevant
acceptanceCriteria: Discovery reads FADE.md for project context
If fade map was run, discovery references its output
Questions reference actual patterns in codebase ('I see you use Express, should this endpoint follow the same pattern as /api/users?')
Flags if proposed feature might conflict with existing code

userStories.title: Reference discovery in PRD execution
userStories.description: As a developer executing a PRD, I want Claude to reference the discovery doc for context
acceptanceCriteria: PRD JSON can include 'discoveryDoc' field pointing to discoveries/*.md
fade run includes referenced discovery doc in context
Discovery doc provides implementation intent beyond acceptance criteria
Optional field - PRDs work fine without discovery docs

technicalNotes.gsdComparison: GSD's discuss-phase captures preferences before planning. FADE's discovery is similar but outputs to file for async PRD writing.
technicalNotes.sessionMode: Discovery is interactive by nature - not automated like fade run. Could use claude without --print.
technicalNotes.integrationWithMap: fade map analyzes code structure. fade discover captures human intent. Together they provide complete context for PRD.
technicalNotes.questionBank: Consider making question sets extensible via standards/discovery-*.md files
